verify.title: Tax Invoice Verification
verify.publicIntro: Verify any Saudi tax invoice QR code without signing in. Everything runs locally in your browser — the invoice is never sent to an external service.
verify.publicSaveHint: Sign in to save the invoice, its items and prices into the system.
verify.scanHint: Use the camera on the QR code, upload an image or PDF, or paste the QR text manually.
verify.badType: Unsupported file type (PDF, JPG or PNG)
verify.noItemsFound: No product lines could be extracted from this invoice
verify.disclaimer: This is a local technical check of the QR code and invoice data only. It is not an official confirmation from ZATCA that the invoice or the business is valid.

verdictHint.green: The QR structure matches the e-invoicing specification and no conflict was found with the invoice data.
verdictHint.yellow: The QR is readable but there are notes or missing parts that need a human review.
verdictHint.red: There is a structural error in the QR, or a conflict in amounts or the VAT number.
verdictHint.gray: No readable QR code was found.

reason.phaseOneOnly: Phase 1 invoice — no cryptographic stamp in the QR
reason.hashNotSha256: Invoice hash is not a valid SHA-256 digest
reason.publicKeyInvalid: Public key could not be read
reason.publicKeyNotP256: Public key is not ECDSA P-256
reason.tlvTrailingBytes: Extra bytes after the last tag
reason.vatFormat: Invalid VAT number format (15 digits starting and ending with 3)
reason.vatOverTotal: VAT amount is greater than the total
reason.mismatch_vatNumber: VAT number in the QR differs from the invoice
reason.mismatch_total: Total in the QR differs from the invoice
reason.minor_sellerName: Seller name differs from the printed one
reason.minor_timestamp: Date differs from the printed one
reason.minor_vatTotal: VAT amount differs from the printed one
